title: SQL database
description: SQL database server. The engine tells consuming charts how to address it.

engine.title: Engine
engine.description: Read by consuming charts to build their JDBC URL.

driver.title: JDBC driver
driver.description: Driver class name read by charts configuring a JDBC datasource. Follows from the engine.

port.title: Port
port.description: 5432 for PostgreSQL, 3306 for MySQL and MariaDB.

username.title: User
username.description: Stored in the credentials Secret, under the username key.

password.title: Password
password.description: Stored in the credentials Secret, under the password key.

sslMode.title: TLS mode
sslMode.description: 'prefer' tries TLS and falls back to clear text if the server refuses, the safe default for a server you do not control. Use 'verify-full' when the server presents a certificate your cluster trusts.

tls.title: TLS mode
tls.description: MySQL accepts a different set of values from PostgreSQL. 'preferred' tries TLS and falls back to clear text.
